checks.description: Fresh schema creates the nine challenge-B tables
product.stock is LONGTEXT and product.offline_reason exists
Order, favorite, cart, receipt and legacy-archive indexes exist
Selling-mode, order-guard and order-item immutability triggers are installed
Money and quantity columns are LONGTEXT; unit prices stay DECIMAL(10,2)
product.stock '-1' is not a canonical non-negative integer (MySQL error 3819)
product.stock '1.5' is not a canonical non-negative integer (MySQL error 3819)
product.stock '007' is not a canonical non-negative integer (MySQL error 3819)
product.stock '' is not a canonical non-negative integer (MySQL error 3819)
product.stock '1e3' is not a canonical non-negative integer (MySQL error 3819)
product.stock ' 5' is not a canonical non-negative integer (MySQL error 3819)
product.stock '5\\n' is not a canonical non-negative integer (MySQL error 3819)
Stock beyond 64-bit and JS safe integers is accepted
The huge stock round-trips as the exact string
Stock 0 is accepted
An auction product cannot hold stock 2 (MySQL error 3819)
offline_reason outside AUTO_ZERO/MANUAL is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
A PLACED order with an unbounded two-decimal total is accepted
A duplicate order number is rejected (MySQL error 1062)
shop_order.status 'FAILED' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
shop_order.total_amount '1.5' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
shop_order.total_amount '01.00' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
shop_order.total_amount '-1.00' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
shop_order.total_amount '1.00\\n' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
shop_order.order_no 'not-a-uuid' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
CANCELLED without initiator/time is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
A non-cancelled order with cancel metadata is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
A cancel time before creation is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
An order for an unknown customer is rejected (MySQL error 1452)
An item with a huge quantity and line amount is accepted
A second line for the same order and product is rejected (MySQL error 1062)
order_item quantity '0' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
order_item quantity '007' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
order_item quantity '1.5' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
order_item quantity '-2' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
A non-positive unit price snapshot is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
order_item.product_name_snapshot is immutable (MySQL error 1644)
order_item.unit_price_snapshot is immutable (MySQL error 1644)
order_item.quantity_snapshot is immutable (MySQL error 1644)
order_item.line_amount_snapshot is immutable (MySQL error 1644)
order_item.product_id is immutable (MySQL error 1644)
Changing the product's name and price does not touch the stored snapshot
The snapshot still holds the original name and unit price
shop_order.total_amount is immutable (MySQL error 1644)
shop_order.order_no is immutable (MySQL error 1644)
shop_order.customer_id is immutable (MySQL error 1644)
shop_order.created_at is immutable (MySQL error 1644)
PLACED -> CONFIRMED is accepted by the database
A seller cancellation with initiator and time is accepted
A cancelled order cannot return to another state (MySQL error 1644)
Cancel metadata of a terminal order cannot be rewritten (MySQL error 1644)
Another order can be completed
A COMPLETED order cannot be cancelled afterwards (MySQL error 1644)
A favorite is stored
A duplicate favorite is rejected (MySQL error 1062)
A favorite for an unknown product is rejected (MySQL error 1452)
Mutation counters are stored
last_cancel_seq above operation_seq is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
A second counter row for the same customer/product is rejected (MySQL error 1062)
A cart row with a huge quantity is stored
cart quantity '0' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
cart quantity '-1' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
cart quantity '1.5' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
cart quantity '007' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
cart quantity '' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
cart quantity '1e2' is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
A second cart row for the same customer/product is rejected (MySQL error 1062)
A removed row id is kept as a tombstone
The same cart row id cannot be tombstoned twice (MySQL error 1062)
Re-adding after deletion gets a new id; the deleted id is never reused
A confirmation with its rows is stored
A duplicate confirmation token is rejected (MySQL error 1062)
A confirmation row with quantity 0 is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
A receipt with a JSON payload is stored
The same (customer, type, key) cannot be stored twice (MySQL error 1062)
The same key is allowed for another operation type or customer
An unknown operation type is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
A non-JSON payload is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
legacy_closed_at without a reason is rejected (MySQL error 3819)
A finished attempt cannot be marked legacy-closed (MySQL error 3819)
V7 adds the new tables, stock LONGTEXT and offline_reason to an iteration-2 + auction database
Existing stock values survive the INT -> text conversion unchanged
offline_reason is initialised for fixed-price OFFLINE rows only (0 stock -> AUTO_ZERO, else MANUAL)
V7 itself changes no intent/attempt/auction row and no product status
Re-running V7 succeeds and changes nothing
V8 runs and reports 3 closed intents, 1 closed attempt, 1 unfrozen and 1 paused product
Live fixed-price intents are marked closed with their original status and snapshot kept
The unfinished fixed-price attempt is marked closed without inventing a result
Trade-frozen fixed-price product returns to ONLINE; manual-frozen becomes OFFLINE/MANUAL; stock untouched
Old SUCCESS/FAILED history is not rewritten
The auction product, session, winner intent and its attempt are not touched
No intent was converted to CANCELLED or FAILED by V8 (unlike the old V4 rule)
Re-running V8 reports zero changes and leaves every row identical
Upgraded schema equals the fresh schema (columns, constraints, checks, indexes, triggers)
V8 on a database without V7 stops and changes nothing
V7 on a database without V6 stops and changes nothing
A frozen product with stock 0 stops V8 before any change, with a recovery message
Simulated interruption leaves the stock CHECKs missing
Re-running V7 re-creates the missing CHECKs and ends equal to the fresh schema
The re-created stock CHECK rejects a negative value again (MySQL error 3819)
Disposable container removed
